comments_data.body:
Thanks @lilitkarapetyan  - I was looking for the functionality in the app, but I now realise it's just in StoryBook at the moment.

One item of feedback:
- for the assets, the Platform `name` is being used for the SVG icon.  We should actually use `platformType` for the icon. That allows the `name` to be changed to `HMS Richmond`.   It's quite acceptable for the name to be empty when the platform/asset is added to the force, though we can't let it stay empty.
![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/44a7a5cd0f6c40ef056a5fdd71457d31.gif)

Second, I don't think we need this toggle:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/117284659-fc6b9580-ae5e-11eb-8889-ba2098b74765.png)

This is specified by the `Location - chosen by player` drop-down menu.

Hello @lilitkarapetyan - I've just had a play with the deployed version.

I see we're nearly there. 

We need to handle the initial location.

There will _either_ be a `LaydownTypes` value in `locationPending` or a value (like `C04`) in `position`.

So, this drop-down will be one of:
* "Umpire laydown"
* "Force laydown"
* "Fixed" - when this is selected, a "Position" text-box will appear, and the value will go in `position`.

**Note:** for now, `Fixed` will be the default option.

I know it may not be easy, but it would be really useful if the `List of Assets` allowed drag/drop to reorganise the data, like we do in `World State`:
https://serge-review-feature-60-opsg41.herokuapp.com/storybook/?path=/story/local-mapping--with-map-bar&args=canSubmitOrders:true;wargameInitiated:true

![Screenshot 2021-05-13 at 11 03 35](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/118110984-00596380-b3db-11eb-8e82-f7b407ba6fad.png)

Hello @lilitkarapetyan - it would be great to get this PR finished, please.

As it diverges further from `develop` it will become more trouble to resolve conflicts.
@lilitkarapetyan - this is seriously a good piece of work: https://serge-review-feature-60-opsg41.herokuapp.com/storybook/?path=/story/local-organisms-adminlayout--default

As I've said before, this is a huge piece of work, thanks :-)

When adding assets to a force, some Game Designers may not be fully familiar with the icons.

So, could we please have the platform-type displayed beneath the icon?

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/123275203-083d1500-d4fc-11eb-922e-e71abdcc254c.png)

## 💬 Brief description of feature
<!-- In a few words, what is this feature -->
We need to implement the pages to get the new `Assets` data.

## 📖 User Story

<!-- A description of the requirements in [Gherkin](https://cucumber.io/docs/gherkin/reference/) format -->
As a **Game Designer** I wish to **Add Assets to Forces** in order to **Design a Wargame**

## ☑️ Acceptance criteria

<!-- - A list of things that can be verified to show that this user story is satisfied. use [markdown checklist format](https://github.blog/2013-01-09-task-lists-in-gfm-issues-pulls-comments/)-->
* [ ] Game Designer can still set Overview & Roles
* [ ] Game Designer can drag/drop assets from list of Platform Types into Assets area
* [ ] Asset UniqiID & ContactID randomly generated (algorithm below)
* [ ] Game Designer able to edit asset Name, ContactId, UniqId

## Generating id values

### UniqId
'a' plus uniqid.time()

### Contact Id

Produce hashcode of uniqid using [this function](https://stackoverflow.com/a/7616484/92441)

Contact Id is `C` plus last 3 digits of hash-code.
